title: Cluster, Route, Escalate: Cascaded Framework for Cost-Aware LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2606.27457v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Serving open-weight language models on premises forces a trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. Hosting models of different sizes lets easy queries go to a small, efficient model and hard ones to a large model. We present CRE-Router (Cluster, Route, Escalate), a two-stage method that decides which of these models answers each query. It clusters queries and routes each cluster to the model that best trades error against cost, under a budget on the time per output token (TPOT) or the end-to-end latency per request (E2EL). It then either accepts the answer or, when a quality estimator rejects it, escalates the query to the strong model. Routing decides before generation, so a hard query goes straight to the strong model; escalation decides after, so it can catch the errors routing cannot predict. translated_title: 聚类、路由、升级：面向成本感知大语言模型服务的级联框架
translated_abstract: 在本地部署开放权重语言模型需要在准确性与计算成本之间进行权衡。托管不同规模的模型可以让简单查询由小型高效模型处理，而困难查询则由大型模型处理。我们提出了CRE-Router（聚类、路由、升级），这是一种两阶段方法，用于决定由哪个模型来回答每个查询。它首先对查询进行聚类，并将每个聚类路由到在错误与成本之间实现最佳权衡的模型，同时遵守每输出标记时间（TPOT）或每请求端到端延迟（E2EL）的预算约束。随后，系统要么接受该答案，要么在质量估计器拒绝该答案时，将查询升级到强大的模型。路由在生成之前做出决策，因此困难查询可以直接发送给强大的模型；升级则在生成之后做出决策，因此可以捕获路由无法预测的错误。除任务正确性标签外，它不需要任何其他标注。我们在TeleMath、TeleQnA和AIME数据集上对CRE-Router进行了评估。
tldr: 提出了CRE-Router两阶段级联框架，在延迟预算约束下先通过聚类将查询路由到成本最优的模型，再通过质量估计将不合格答案升级到更强的模型，从而在大语言模型服务中兼顾准确率与计算成本。
en_tdlr: CRE-Router, a two-stage cascaded framework that clusters and routes queries to cost-optimal models under latency budgets and escalates rejected answers to stronger models, balancing accuracy and computational cost in LLM serving.
